Subject: Severe latency + 429s in production — urgent

Hi Rafael,

We're seeing a serious degradation from our side since ~14:30 PDT today. Our monitoring shows p95 up ~2.2x and p99 requests spiking above 4.5s; additionally ~12% of requests to Redwood are returning 429s which then trigger client retries and amplify the tail. This is impacting our payment flows and we have transactions timing out.

Attached are a handful of request IDs and traces from our ops dashboard (ops@maplebank.com will share the raw logs). Can you confirm whether this is due to a change on your side or a rate limit interaction? We need an ETA for mitigation — this is impacting customers.

Thanks,
Samantha

Subject: Re: Severe latency + 429s in production — urgent

Thanks for the trace, Samantha. Early findings from the runtime:
- We see a cohort of high-concurrency connections from MapleBank that generated sustained parallel requests to the same session keys. When their first wave hit a soft per-customer rate limit, client-side retries (fixed short backoff) reissued many requests almost immediately.
- This produced queueing at the per-worker request queue, increasing tail latency (p99) and producing more 429s downstream as Token quota enforcement kicked in.
- No config rollouts on our side at 14:00 — this appears to be an interaction between request fanout + client retry semantics.

Immediate engineering mitigations (0-2 hours):
1) Increase MapleBank's per-customer soft limit by 2x for the next 4 hours (to drain backlog).
2) Enable request deduplication at the gateway for repeated identical payloads within 500ms (experimental flag).
3) Temporarily accept lower concurrency for low-priority routes (payments should be high priority).

I'll attach a short log extract and recommended runbook steps (see attachment). We need the request IDs Samantha provided and a sample of the client retry settings to tune backoff.

— Markus Klein
Sr. Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: maplebank_traces_0829.log (engineered extract)

Team — brief executive summary for decision:
- Impact: MapleBank p99 up to ~4.8s, ~12% 429 rate, measurable customer transaction failures. Potential revenue impact if flows continue >2 hours.
- Root cause (prelim): Client retry fanout interacting with per-customer rate limiting, producing queueing and tail amplification.
- Proposed immediate actions (requires exec sign-off):
  1) Allow a temporary 2x soft-limit increase for MapleBank for the next 4 hours (risk: higher short-term cost).
  2) Authorize emergency credits up to $5k if the incident causes measurable lost transactions (for customer goodwill).
  3) Approve a post-incident engineering ticket (SUP-4321) to harden gateway backoff/dedupe and expose per-customer metrics.

Asks: Please reply ALL with APPROVE/DECLINE for items (1) and (2). I will stand by to implement on approval.

— Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
